questions.question: Can two categories have the same name, and what happens when one is added or renamed to a name already taken?
questions.key: Category names are unique. Exact match, case-sensitive; adding or renaming to a taken name throws DuplicateCategoryName and leaves the stored rows unchanged.
questions.notes: Dry-run fixture, not part of the pre-registered question set.

questions.question: How are monetary amounts stored in the database, and what happens to the older double columns?
questions.key: Amounts are stored as integer minor units (*Minor fields), so sums are exact. The legacy double columns stay in the schema until the column-retirement release and are deprecated; only lib/db/migrations reads them.

questions.notes: An ignored entry is never scheduled.
